scope: Independent review of the HHD decision amendment, grounded in the official HS results, visible SAP and primary sponsor release. This is not a patient-level reanalysis or verification of implemented trial code.
independence: The reviewer read the sponsor report and controlling Round 7/10 documents before the authored amendment, then independently inspected the complete registry results module and relevant SAP text and rendered pages. The final claim files were checked against those sources.

checks.finding: HS activity is kept distinct from HHD efficacy, ATP2C1 correction, HHD patient counts and an HHD response probability.

All five continuous-outcome rows match registry displayed counts, arm LS means, reported contrasts, 95% intervals and P values. The primary reported difference remains -1.20 rather than subtraction of rounded means.
Pain and itch uncertainty is interpreted as lack of demonstrated superiority, not equivalence, proven harm or established absence of benefit.
Randomized 34/35, lesion display N24/32 and symptom display N23/22 remain distinct. The table counts are not asserted to identify everyone who contributed earlier data to MMRM.
No categorical responder numerators or nonresponder-imputation rule are invented from the rounded percentages. Overlapping lesion outcomes are not counted as independent replications.
Registry MMRM description and ANCOVA field, planned ITT analysis and observed-data reporting remain separate. The implementation and informative-missingness robustness are not claimed verified.

Visible SAP supports all-randomized planned primary analysis, unstructured MMRM covariance, two-sided alpha0.1, approximate60-person sample without power calculation, and the four-of-seven diary requirement. None is imported into HHD as a validated rule.
Sponsor and registry symptom/IHS4 values are preserved separately. An unverified raw-versus-adjusted explanation or numerical averaging is not used.

The extension is correctly limited to eligible week16 completers without safety concerns; both groups receive active cream. It does not establish vehicle-controlled maintenance or drug-free durability. A possible original-allocation strategy interpretation is qualified rather than erased.

DBVC and OLE any-TEAE and grade>=3 counts match the registry. Severity is distinguished from serious-event status, and pooled active exposure includes crossover recipients rather than independent randomized groups.
Sparse HS safety counts do not establish causal drug harm, comparative long-term risk or an HHD exposure margin. Safety follow-up windows remain visible.
The vehicle comparison does not establish this project's control supply or superiority to HHD active care. Existing matched-vehicle or protocolized whole-product add-on alternatives are retained.

The seven-row claim map adds an explicit evidence-to-claim interpretation while acknowledging that controlled proof, clinical relevance, missingness and maintenance safeguards already governed Round7.
Rank3,10 points, HHD primary-outcome alternatives, duration assumptions, advancement rules and optional-model scope remain unchanged; no new power, threshold, S-tier or asset promotion is introduced.
The work is literature interpretation and integrity checking; it neither performs nor authorizes clinical or model execution. Closed retrieval lanes remain closed.

sources_read.scope: Complete local official JSON results module, study flow, analysis fields and safety groups read; hash verified.
Visible primary-analysis, sample-size and symptom-diary text read. Rendered printed pages24-25 viewed. No redacted content reconstructed.
10March2024 sponsor report independently read through primary web source; retrieval reference turn227view0.
Controlling clinical claim, estimand, comparator and advance/stop requirements.
HHD case accounting and clinical evidence limits.
Existing active-care interpretation and whole-product fallback.

source_limits: The reviewer's fresh PubMed open returned a footer; the complete journal article and supplement were not independently read. Registry-supported conclusions do not depend on adjudicating the article's full safety presentation.

The SAP pre-existing-AN endpoint paragraph contains an ambiguous parenthetical about new AN; the registry clearly defines baseline-affected anatomical areas. The decision explicitly follows the registry definition and does not claim implemented analysis verification. The methods reviewer separately records this wording limit.
Phase3 design and sponsor forecast links are context, not completed outcomes or HHD validation. They were not independently re-retrieved by this decision reviewer.
No individual data, analytic code, hidden redactions, exact model-contributor count or validated HHD meaningful-change threshold were recovered by this review.
